messages:
maria (DevEx): heads-up — a few folks on the onboarding sample app are seeing a flurry of soft 429s after the first paginated iterate. Happens right after token refresh + a handful of concurrent retries. anyone run into this pattern?

jake (SDK): seen similar in an internal repro. SDK default retry kicks in + prefetching next pages = local spike. sampleapp also does parallel cursor warmup on start.

samir (Platform): logs from the gateway show a concentrated window where auth service returns 202->retry and clients re-fire immediately. combined with sampleapp prefetch that causes a burst of inflight requests for the same user key.

maria (DevEx): can you paste the minimal repro steps? we should keep this short for users. also is this a parity issue between js/go sdk behaviours?

jake (SDK): quick repro: start sampleapp with --prefetch=2 and simulate token expiry. SDK currently retries auth refresh inline and then replays inflight requests immediately. snippet from sampleapp config: ```js
// naive startup prefetch
sampleClient.prefetchPages({concurrency: 3, immediate: true});
```

olivia (Onboard): we enabled that parallel prefetch to make UX feel snappier on first load. didn't expect it to amplify token-race scenarios. proposal: make initial prefetch sequential with small pacing and jitter during token boundary.

samir (Platform): agreed. platform can also add a short server-side token-cooldown header so clients can back off for a few hundred ms after refresh storms. but we should fix client-side first.

jake (SDK): plan: 1) add jittered exponential backoff on auth-refresh retries (opt-out flag), 2) change prefetch helper to respect a `startupPacingMs` and default to 250ms, 3) add guidance in onboarding sample. i'll open a PR.

maria (DevEx): can we also add a small circuit for duplicate inflight page requests (dedupe by cursor+user) so we don't replay identical work? would help other SDK users.

jake (SDK): yeah, dedupe is low-risk. will include in PR. tentative: dedupe table keyed by (userId,cursor) with 300ms amortize window.

olivia (Onboard): patch idea (pseudo): ```diff
- prefetchPages({concurrency:3, immediate:true})
+ prefetchPages({concurrency:1, startupPacingMs:250, jitter:true})
```

maria (DevEx): test plan: run attach load test for onboarding flow, simulate token expiry churn, verify 429 rate under threshold, and ensure UX latency not regress >150ms. @devex-bot can you schedule a small run? :eyes: :chart_with_upwards_trend:

devex-bot: loadtest queued: onboarding-token-pulsecheck, expected run in 10m, reporter set to maria.

jake (SDK): PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4821 (draft) — includes auth jitter, dedupe, and new sampleapp defaults. marking opt-out for existing users.

maria (DevEx): thanks. once load test passes, can we update the onboarding quickstart doc and add a short note in SDK changelog about the opt-out flag and recommended startupPacingMs?

samir (Platform): i'll follow-up on server-side cooldown header proposal in infra channel and post the header spec.

maria (DevEx): awesome. keeping this thread for the short-term fixes, will move to a follow-up doc if we need platform changes. :thumbsup:
